title: Bind the shared shopper SDK lane to server-issued session capabilities
scope: Introduce domain-separated server-signed shopper capabilities with server-generated anonymous subject and profile-session IDs. Bind the shared direct realtime shopper routes, identity link/detach, decisions snapshot and product sort to verified tenant/subject/session before effects; no legacy-cookie, user-pointer or anonymous-forward promotion in this lane. Integrate bootstrap, header and WebSocket-subprotocol credentials into the shared SDK, rotate local identity state on detach and discard same-client stale asynchronous/socket results. Preserve deterministic ranking and existing asynchronous session-write behavior.
non_goals: No claim of full W04/F04/F06/N05 closure or engine-wide isolation. Copied unexpired credential revocation, cross-client/tab logout, in-flight server effects across logout/link/erase, transactional consent/deletion authority and forwarding lifecycle remain open. Local SDK generations are not server revocation.

No bespoke legacy demo/CDP/tracking/operator API migration or bypass; callers lacking valid credentials are refused on the guarded lane. Customer surface and production authority decisions D01/D03/D06/D07 remain pending; no customer policy or session SLA selected.

No new store/binding/cloud/credential/provision/deploy/customer-data/operational script, stage/commit/push, destructive cleanup, scoring/model/ledger redesign, new harness or broad historical contract revalidation. Root alone governs admission/tracker/source/acceptance.

criteria.description: Actual bootstrap issues only fresh unpredictable anonymous IDs or verifies an existing bounded capability; never signs caller-selected IDs or reconstructs legacy cookie profile. Validated signing config, strict tenant/subject/session/kind/time claims, non-JWT domain and header/subprotocol transport reject missing/forged/malformed/expired/wrong-tenant credentials before profile, capture, DO, ledger or connector effects. Signed account link additionally proves browser ownership before merge, preserving backend proof and fresh signed retry controls.

Guard shared direct realtime action/personalization/reflex/preferences/analytics/reset/segments/subject-connections, identity link/detach, decisions snapshot and sort. Use verified exact subject/session on both hosts with no user-pointer/old-cookie/anonymous-forward promotion; match or explicitly separate correlation fields. SDK bootstrap is coalesced, authenticated fetch/keepalive and WS subprotocol use no credential URL, both generated bundles match source. Local generation/identity rotation discards stale hydrate/action/identify/socket results and resets cached decisions; deterministic ranking, consent refusals and deferred writes retain focused positive controls.

Existing actual-entry workerd fixture proves compact capability bootstrap/denial and real socket boundary behavior on both hosts, including frame subject and expiry/private delivery boundaries. Source/evidence review states exactly what was executed; no synthetic 101 substitutes for runtime upgrade proof or SLO claim.

Independent frozen actual source/baseline/fixtures/worker evidence review, exact required reruns and relevant artifact identity; inspect application and SDK noEmit/build/bundle syntax/scoped diff. Root separately accepts bounded lane containment, preserving first failures, historical W04.01 proof and all strong revocation/customer/perimeter limits.
